descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-16 ER; TFA-92594 AC 3, AC 4 · “entries display collapsed with a line count and expand to the correct, correctly-attributed full transcript”.

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S01 Hospital: archived and current sessions listed collapsed with line counts; expand shows the full, speaker-labelled transcript; one open at a time

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 The physician can open Prior Encounter Transcripts for a patient, and the prior encounters are listed there automatically. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 2; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 4; TFA-92594 How it works 4)
  • U5 The expanded transcript is correctly attributed: each line shows the right speaker (Physician / Patient), and the transcript sits under the right patient and visit. (UAT TC-16)
  • T1 Functionality and design match the p72 prototype's TranscriptHistory: row style, line-count chip, chevron, one open at a time, and longer lists folded into 'Earlier sessions'. (TFA-92594 AC 1)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium test: Hospital patient with one archived row 'Sep 23 · Encounter notes' (1 line) and a current transcript of 2 lines (Dr 09:12 AM, Pt 09:13 AM) whose transcriptDate is a past day

When Open the Encounter tab, then expand 'Most Recent', then expand the archived row

Then Section 'Prior Encounter Transcripts' visible. Rows show '1 lines' and '2 lines', with text hidden until a row is opened. Most Recent shows 'Physician' / 'Patient' and '09:13 AM' on the right lines. Opening the archived row closes Most Recent

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: toContainText('1 lines' / '2 lines') on each row (U3); patient line toBeHidden before the click (U3 collapsed); after the click, getByText(patient line).locator('..') toContainText 'Patient' and '09:13 AM' and the physician line 'Physician' (U4, U5, row-scoped, on the Most Recent row); aria-expanded true/false, one open at a time (T1). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S01

Hospital: archived and current sessions listed collapsed with line counts; expand shows the full, speaker-labelled transcript; one open at a time

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-16.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • prior-transcripts.spec.ts [chromium] — lists archived sessions and the current transcript, one open at a time — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec e2e/prior-transcripts.spec.ts, chromium): it signs in a fresh @roundai.test account through e2e/support (local admin key) and writes the archived row and the past-day transcript with rounding:add / rounding:update from the test; dev has no admin key and one shared ac….
